explanation: Hong Kong Island was ceded in 1842, but most of the territory was leased in 1898 for 99 years. Portugal returned nearby Macau to China in 1999.
learnMore: Transfer of sovereignty over Hong Kong

claims.text: Britain transferred Hong Kong to China on 1 July 1997.
Britain had ruled Hong Kong Island since 1842, more than 150 years before 1997.
Macau was handed to China by Portugal in 1999, Singapore became independent in 1965, and Shanghai's British-run settlement ended in 1943.
Hong Kong Island was ceded to Britain in 1842.
Most of Hong Kong's land area, the New Territories, was leased to Britain in 1898 for 99 years.
Portugal handed Macau to China in 1999.
